title: Opus 5 Crushed GPT 5.6 Sol on ARC AGI 3 by 4x
description:
Opus 5 just beat GPT 5.6 Sol on ARC AGI 3 by almost 4x 🔥

Score: 30.2% vs the old record of 7.8%. That benchmark was literaly built to be a wall for AI models.

And the creators say it's first time they watched a model invent algebraic equations on its own 😅 Nothing else has done that.

4x gap isn't memorizing patterns anymore ✨

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
